name: application-toast-action-undo
title: Toast Action Undo
description: Snackbar-style toast components with a countdown indicator and inline Undo action for reversible operations.
useWhen: Snackbar-style toast components with a countdown indicator and inline Undo action for reversible operations.
avoidWhen: Avoid toast action undo when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Toast Action Undo uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
